q.en: Is it safe to travel to India?

a.en: Yes, India is generally safe for tourists. Our expert guides ensure your comfort and security at all times. We carefully plan routes and accommodations for the safest experience.

q.en: What is the best time to visit India?
q.es: ¿Cuál es la mejor época para visitar la India?

a.en: October to March is ideal for most regions. South India can be visited year-round. We'll help you choose the perfect timing based on your itinerary and interests.

featuredMonuments.name: Taj Mahal
featuredMonuments.desc: A UNESCO World Heritage ivory-white marble mausoleum, widely considered the finest example of Mughal architecture and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

featuredMonuments.name: Amber Fort
featuredMonuments.desc: A majestic sandstone and marble fortress perched on a hillside, featuring stunning mirror work, elephant rides, and panoramic views of Maota Lake.

featuredMonuments.name: Mehrangarh Fort
featuredMonuments.desc: One of India's largest forts towering 125 meters above the Blue City, with intricate carvings, expansive courtyards, and a museum of royal artifacts.

featuredMonuments.name: Hawa Mahal
featuredMonuments.desc: The iconic Palace of Winds with 953 small windows designed for royal women to observe street festivals without being seen from outside.

featuredMonuments.name: Mysore Palace
featuredMonuments.desc: A grand Indo-Saracenic palace illuminated by 97,000 lights on Sundays and public holidays, home to the Wadiyar royal family's treasures.

featuredMonuments.name: Hampi Ruins
featuredMonuments.desc: The sprawling UNESCO ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire, featuring over 1,600 surviving monuments including temples, royal enclosures, and market streets.

title.es: Guía de Viaje: Visa y Entrada
title.pt: Guia de Viagem: Visto e Entrada

heroSubtitle.en: Everything you need to enter India seamlessly
heroSubtitle.es: Todo lo necesario para entrar a India
heroSubtitle.pt: Tudo que precisa para entrar na Índia

content.en: India offers an electronic visa (e-Visa) system for citizens of 150+ countries. The e-Tourist Visa allows stays of up to 90 days for tourism, sightseeing, and casual visits. Applications are processed online within 72 hours, and the visa is valid for 1 year from the date of issue with double entry permitted.
content.es: India ofrece un sistema de visa electrónica para ciudadanos de más de 150 países. La e-Visa turística permite estancias de hasta 90 días.
content.pt: A Índia oferece um sistema de visto eletrônico para cidadãos de mais de 150 países.

es: Pasaporte válido con 6+ meses de validez
pt: Passaporte válido com 6+ meses de validade

content.en: Standard processing takes 3-5 business days. Urgent processing is available within 24-48 hours. Visa fees range from $25-80 depending on nationality and duration. We recommend applying at least 2 weeks before your travel date. MH India Trips provides complimentary visa assistance for all booked guests.
content.es: El procesamiento estándar toma 3-5 días hábiles. Las tarifas varían de $25-80.
content.pt: O processamento padrão leva 3-5 dias úteis. As taxas variam de $25-80.

content.en: Upon arrival at Delhi, Mumbai, or any major airport, proceed to the e-Visa immigration counter. Keep a printed copy of your e-Visa approval. Immigration typically takes 15-30 minutes. Our private chauffeurs will be waiting at the arrivals hall with a personalized name board. All MH India Trips guests receive VIP airport fast-track assistance.
content.es: Al llegar a Delhi, Mumbai o cualquier aeropuerto principal, diríjase al mostrador de e-Visa.
content.pt: Ao chegar em Delhi, Mumbai ou qualquer aeropuerto principal, dirija-se ao balcão de e-Visto.

title.es: Guía de Viaje: Mejor época y clima
title.pt: Guia de Viagem: Melhor época e clima

heroSubtitle.en: Season-by-season guide to India's diverse climates
heroSubtitle.es: Guía estación por estación del clima de India
heroSubtitle.pt: Guia estação por estação do clima da Índia

content.en: The ideal time for most of India. Pleasant temperatures (15-30°C), clear skies, and minimal rainfall. Perfect for Rajasthan, Kerala, Goa, Delhi, Agra, and most heritage destinations. December-January can be cool in the north (5-15°C). This is wedding season, so book accommodations and flights well in advance.
content.es: El momento ideal para la mayor parte de India. Temperaturas agradables, cielos despejados.
content.pt: O momento ideal para a maior parte da Índia. Temperaturas agradáveis, céus limpos.

content.en: Hot in plains (35-45°C) but excellent for Himalayan hill stations like Shimla, Manali, Darjeeling, and Ladakh. Less crowded, better hotel rates. Ideal for mountain retreats and tea plantation tours. Southern India remains manageable with beach destinations.
content.es: Caluroso en las llanuras pero excelente para estaciones de montaña del Himalaya.
content.pt: Quente nas planícies mas excelente para estações de montanha do Himalaia.

content.en: Lush green landscapes, Ayurvedic rejuvenation season in Kerala, and dramatic waterfalls. Rajasthan gets refreshing rains. Avoid coastal areas and hill roads during heavy rains. Best for: Kerala Ayurveda retreats, Rajasthan photography, Meghalaya living root bridges.
content.es: Paisajes verdes exuberantes, temporada de Ayurveda en Kerala.
content.pt: Paisagens verdes exuberantes, temporada de Ayurveda em Kerala.

en: North India (Delhi, Agra, Rajasthan): Best Oct-Mar, hot Apr-Jun
South India (Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu): Year-round, peak Nov-Mar
Himalayas (Ladakh, Himachal, Uttarakhand): May-Oct for trekking
East India (Kolkata, Darjeeling, NE States): Oct-Mar ideal
Goa & Beaches: Nov-Feb peak, monsoon Jul-Sep for quiet beauty
es: Sur: Todo el año, pico Nov-Mar
pt: Sul: Todo o ano, pico Nov-Mar

heroSubtitle.en: India welcomes solo women travelers with warmth and safety
heroSubtitle.es: India da la bienvenida a mujeres viajeras solas
heroSubtitle.pt: A Índia dá as boas-vindas a mulheres viajantes sozinhas

content.en: All our solo female travelers receive a dedicated female guide option, verified male drivers with background checks, 24/7 emergency concierge hotline, GPS-tracked vehicles, and vetted luxury hotel accommodations. We've safely hosted 500+ solo female travelers from 40+ countries with zero safety incidents.
content.es: Todas nuestras viajeras solas reciben guía femenina dedicada, conductores verificados, línea de emergencia 24/7.
content.pt: Todas as nossas viajantes sozinhas recebem guia feminina dedicada, motoristas verificados, linha de emergência 24/7.

content.en: India is generally conservative. We recommend covering shoulders and knees at temples and rural areas. In cities like Delhi and Mumbai, western clothing is perfectly fine. Carry a light scarf for temple visits. Our guides will always advise on appropriate attire for each location.
content.es: India es generalmente conservadora. Recomendamos cubrir hombros y rodillas en templos.
content.pt: A Índia é geralmente conservadora. Recomendamos cobrir ombros e joelhos em templos.

en: Kerala - Peaceful backwaters and wellness retreats
Rajasthan - Palace stays with dedicated female staff
Goa - Safe beach culture with international community
Himachal Pradesh - Mountain retreats and yoga centers
Udaipur - Romantic lake city with boutique hotels

content.en: Emergency police: 100 | Women helpline: 1091 | Tourist police: 1363. All MH India Trips guests receive our 24/7 WhatsApp concierge number. Our local team is always within 30-minute reach in all operating cities.

title.es: Guía de Viaje: Vacunas y salud
title.pt: Guia de Viagem: Vacinação e saúde

heroSubtitle.en: Stay healthy throughout your India journey
heroSubtitle.es: Mantente saludable durante tu viaje a India
heroSubtitle.pt: Mantenha-se saudável durante sua viagem à Índia

content.en: Carry: anti-diarrheal (Imodium), rehydration salts, antihistamines, sunscreen SPF50+, insect repellent (DEET-based), hand sanitizer, water purification tablets, and any personal prescriptions. Pharmacies are widely available in India and most medicines are affordable over-the-counter.
content.es: Lleve: antidiarreico, sales de rehidratación, antihistamínicos, protector solar SPF50+, repelente de insectos.
content.pt: Leve: antidiarreico, sais de reidratação, anti-histamínicos, protetor solar SPF50+, repelente de insetos.

content.en: Drink only bottled or filtered water (our hotels provide complimentary purified water). Street food is an experience but stick to freshly cooked hot items. All MH India Trips restaurant recommendations are vetted for hygiene standards. We provide filtered water bottles in all private vehicles.
content.es: Beba solo agua embotellada o filtrada. La comida callejera debe estar recién cocinada.
content.pt: Beba apenas água engarrafada ou filtrada. A comida de rua deve estar recém cozinhada.

content.en: We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance covering medical emergencies, trip cancellation, and baggage loss. India has excellent private hospitals in all major cities. MH India Trips maintains partnerships with top hospitals for priority access if needed.
content.es: Recomendamos seguro de viaje completo que cubra emergencias médicas.
content.pt: Recomendamos seguro de viagem completo que cubra emergências médicas.

en: Light cotton clothing (layerable for temperature changes)
es: Gafas de sol, sombrero y protector solar
pt: Óculos de sol, chapéu e protetor solar

content.en: Winter (Nov-Feb): Warm layers, thermal wear for North India mornings. Summer (Mar-Jun): Extra light fabrics, cooling towel. Monsoon (Jul-Sep): Waterproof bag covers, quick-dry clothing, umbrella. Hill stations: Warm fleece/jacket regardless of season.
content.es: Invierno: Capas cálidas para el Norte. Verano: Telas extra ligeras. Monzón: Ropa impermeable.
content.pt: Inverno: Camadas quentes para o Norte. Verão: Tecidos extra leves. Monção: Roupa impermeável.

heading.es: Rupia India y Cambio de Moneda

content.en: Currency: Indian Rupee (INR/₹). 1 USD ≈ 83 INR (approx). Exchange at airport or authorized dealers. ATMs available everywhere. Visa/Mastercard widely accepted in cities and hotels. Carry small denominations (₹100-500) for tips and local markets. UPI payments (Google Pay) are universal in India. MH India Trips handles all major payments digitally.
content.es: Moneda: Rupia India (INR). 1 USD ≈ 83 INR. Cajeros en todas partes. Visa/Mastercard aceptados.
content.pt: Moeda: Rúpia Indiana (INR). 1 USD ≈ 83 INR. Caixas eletrônicos em toda parte. Visa/Mastercard aceitos.

content.en: Tipping is appreciated but not mandatory. Suggested: Hotel porter ₹100-200, restaurant 10% of bill, private driver ₹500-1000/day, guide ₹1000-2000/day, spa therapist 10-15%. MH India Trips provides tipping guidelines specific to your itinerary.
content.es: Las propinas se aprecian pero no son obligatorias. Sugerido: Portero ₹100-200, restaurante 10%.
content.pt: As gorjetas são apreciadas mas não obrigatórias. Sugerido: Porteiro ₹100-200, restaurante 10%.
